Subject: Office-hours 'Deep Dive' — possible slots (group session)

Hi all —

Thanks for the interest in a grouped "Deep Dive" on inference economics and deployment patterns. We'll run a single 45-minute office hours session that groups a few prospects so you can hear peer Q&A. Candidate slots:

- Tue Aug 31, 09:00 AM PT (45 min)
- Wed Sep 1, 12:00 PM PT (45 min)
- Thu Sep 2, 05:00 PM PT (45 min)

Please reply with your preferred slot (rank 1-3) and any must-have topics. I'll consolidate and send a final calendar invite + updated agenda. Capacity is intentionally limited (two companies per session) — if we can't fit everyone we'll run a second rotation.

Draft agenda attached (one-pager): high-level KPIs, sample prompt deck, common infra blockers, and Q&A.

Links: calendar poll: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
Attachment: office-hours-deep-dive-agenda-v2.pdf (1 page, PDF)

Thanks —
